{"id":"ENG-2412","uuid":"9153e532-2ad1-4043-b2e7-6ae4edf446f1","title":"Decide the upsert path for Roam and Obsidian writes","description":"## Problem

* The sub-issues of this ticket decide one question: how Roam and Obsidian write nodes, relations and schemas to the database.
* Deciding them one at a time gives conflicting answers. <issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue> marks the upsert route out of scope, but the 2026-07-17 meeting agreed to change <issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue> to use the route.

## Solution

* Decide the sub-issues in this order: <issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">FEE-890</issue>, then <issue id="d629770f-e952-4a33-80e4-3beabcd55ea3" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-891/test-the-generic-upsert-route">FEE-891</issue> and <issue id="0c10cf7e-b560-4efd-893e-bb9f5ec3a14d" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2005/zod-validators-for-the-cross-app-types">ENG-2005</issue>, then <issue id="b2336c31-b4ea-4e9a-886f-cf8e81c55e6a" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1794/atomic-upsert-of-concept-and-content">ENG-1794</issue> with <issue id="9969e706-c4c9-4405-ad9e-70f888d270b9" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian">ENG-1823</issue> and <issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue>, then <issue id="d1d8aa4e-e2ff-40f2-94c2-a6a8b36c2189" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2166/make-upsertconcepts-more-like-a-patch-than-put">ENG-2166</issue>.
* Record each decision as a `Decision:` comment on its ticket.

## Done When

* Every sub-issue has a `Decision:` comment.
* Every sub-issue is in Architecture Refactors or closed.

## Out of Scope

* Building the upsert route or changing any write path. The sub-issues cover that work.

## Notes

* Blocks <issue id="b90793f4-5dc0-40fc-9942-95895531ba24" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2413/decide-how-roam-and-obsidian-move-onto-the-crossapp-types">ENG-2413</issue>.

{"id":"ENG-2091","uuid":"e17cf3a1-ece8-497e-a8b4-a44ea6b9be09","title":"Unify SharedNode and CrossAppNode","description":"## Problem

* We have two types that represent an abstraction of a node. This makes for a larger cognitive surface.
* There are aspects of SharedNode that are missing from CrossAppNode: sourceId, directMetadata (equivalent to literal_content?) and reference_content (missing)
* We have a lot of code that started using the SharedNode and will need refactoring.

## Solution

* Add the missing fields to CrossAppNodes.
* Take the functions that create SharedNodes from database data, and create equivalent functions that create CrossAppNodes instead
* Start using those new functions in the client code
* Remove SharedNodes

## Done When

* We have removed SharedNodes without loss of functionality

## Out of Scope

* Adding functionality, adjacent refators.

## Notes

{"id":"ENG-2165","uuid":"8f04a7a2-c757-47d2-b12f-c918a32b77ea","title":"Refactor Roam Sync to use crossAppNodes","description":"## Problem

* We have two paths to write to the database: sync and publish. They use different converters, which violates DRY.
* We want the sync to use the same CrossApp converters a publish.

## Solution

* Large-scale: Rewrite the sync to use the publish converters.
  * To be broken down in sub-tasks
* This is not code I think we should check in as-is, but Claude-generated code which I sent to help us understand the scope and surface.

## Done When

* The old sync path using RoamFullContentNode is removed.
  * This will include <issue id="17320a42-9f07-49ff-bc23-ba9586e335bf" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2061/refactor-roamfullcontentnode-to-use-crossappnode-contract">ENG-2061</issue> 
* The sync path only upserts Concepts, with embedded Content, vs the two phases we have now.
  * <issue id="b2336c31-b4ea-4e9a-886f-cf8e81c55e6a" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1794/atomic-upsert-of-concept-and-content">ENG-1794</issue> 
  * 

## Out of Scope

* 

## Notes

* We still need to handle the discrepancy between direct and direct_and_description
  * Separate task but describing here
  * Published nodes with isFirst child need both to be maintained by sync
    * In sync, we can put the direct_and_description variant in the direct field of the Content (for isFirstChild nodes)
    * And send the direct variant of published, isFirstChild nodes at sync, as a separate content upsert.
  * Nodes without isFirstChild need only direct, so that is what sync will send.
* I had Claude do this, thinking it appropriate while working on <issue id="2565264d-8db7-4380-97b8-aad006e7e143" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2128/express-source-as-a-sourcedocument-slotreference-of-evidence">ENG-2128</issue>. It was decided that the testing would take too long, so it will be delayed. Still thinking it's worth examining the choices made while writing that code.
* Here are some decision points identified by Claude while doing this.
  * Investigation — why schema updates never landed
    * Two independent sync paths, disagreeing: publishNodesToGroups used the cross-app converters but only inserted schemas missing from my_concepts; syncDgNodesToSupabase re-upserted schemas but through converters that emitted no slots and put template content under the template key that Obsidian reads as a template name.
    * The server was never the constraint — upsert_concepts already does ON CONFLICT … DO UPDATE. Both gaps were client-side.
    * nodeTypeSince misses child-block edits (it tests :edit/time on the type block, while format lives in a child). Still unfixed; it means schema changes reach the DB mainly via sharedNodeTypeIds.

    sync-should-use-CrossApp
    * Concept names preserved for block-backed nodes ("{page title} {block text}") — otherwise every such concept would be renamed against a unique (space_id, name) index.
    * Variant became a property of the content, not of the slot it sits in — your design. That let the direct slot host a direct_and_description.
    * Missing first child → plain direct — your call.
    * The two-phase sync collapsed into one — your call, and it retired the withContents flag I'd added as a workaround. You read that flag correctly as a symptom.
    * Embeddings only for changed nodes — a node present solely for a full-content backfill hasn't changed and keeps its own.
    * CONCEPT_BATCH_SIZE 200 → 50, since concepts now carry full page markdown.
    * slot → defaultVariant — my rename collided with Concept.slots.
    * RoamFullContentNode removed, and times declared number (option A) rather than widened to string | number — number is both narrower and true, since all three producers are datalog rows.
    * Telemetry attribution shifts — markdown building moved into the getSharedFullContentUpdates phase; you accepted that.

    Deferred, deliberately
    * nodeTypeSince's blindness to child-block edits.
    * A published isFirstChild node sending both a direct_and_description and a plain direct (recorded as a comment in roamToCrossAppConverters.ts).
    * Producers returning CrossAppNode directly, together with folding node-type content into schema concepts — they share the upsertNodeSchemaToContent ## Solution

* Decide the sub-issues in this order: <issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">FEE-890</issue>, then <issue id="d629770f-e952-4a33-80e4-3beabcd55ea3" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-891/test-the-generic-upsert-route">FEE-891</issue> and <issue id="0c10cf7e-b560-4efd-893e-bb9f5ec3a14d" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2005/zod-validators-for-the-cross-app-types">ENG-2005</issue>, then <issue id="b2336c31-b4ea-4e9a-886f-cf8e81c55e6a" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1794/atomic-upsert-of-concept-and-content">ENG-1794</issue> with <issue id="9969e706-c4c9-4405-ad9e-70f888d270b9" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian">ENG-1823</issue> and <issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue>, then <issue id="d1d8aa4e-e2ff-40f2-94c2-a6a8b36c2189" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2166/make-upsertconcepts-more-like-a-patch-than-put">ENG-2166</issue>.

* Every sub-issue has a `Decision:` comment.

{"id":"ENG-1823","uuid":"9969e706-c4c9-4405-ad9e-70f888d270b9","title":"Use the unified upsert_concepts in Obsidian","description":"## Problem

* Obsidian sync writes Concepts and Content in separate calls, to `upsert_concepts` and `upsert_content`. If one call fails, we have partially defined nodes in the database.
* `upsert_concepts` accepts Content embedded in each Concept since <issue id="b66b4d29-6edc-4fbe-bbbc-4cfaab6f9834" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1822/modify-upsert-concepts-so-it-accepts-embedded-content">ENG-1822</issue>, so one call can write the full node.

## Solution

* Remove the call to `upsert_content`. Send each node with its Content in a single call.

**Open decisions**

1. Does the single call go through the upsert route (<issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">FEE-890</issue>) or straight to `upsert_concepts`? On 2026-07-17 we agreed on the route. <issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">FEE-890</issue> has to confirm that still holds after v0.
2. <issue id="f1c9f2d5-4eac-47d8-b4a5-a862196ef911" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas">ENG-1986</issue> (Obsidian sync onto the cross-app converters) overlaps this ticket. Is it a step of this ticket, or does it replace this ticket? <issue id="b90793f4-5dc0-40fc-9942-95895531ba24" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2413/decide-how-roam-and-obsidian-move-onto-the-crossapp-types">ENG-2413</issue> decides this.

## Done When

* There is no `upsert_content` call left in the Obsidian codebase.

## Out of Scope

## Notes

* Today's calls: `upsert_concepts` in `syncDgNodesToSupabase.ts`, and `upsert_content` in `upsertNodesAsContentWithEmbeddings.ts`.
* History:
  * 2026-05-30: Marc-Antoine created this, with no description, as the Obsidian half of <issue id="b2336c31-b4ea-4e9a-886f-cf8e81c55e6a" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1794/atomic-upsert-of-concept-and-content">ENG-1794</issue>.

{"id":"ENG-1824","uuid":"dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f","title":"Use the unified upsert_concepts in Roam","description":"## Problem

* Roam sync writes Concepts and Content in separate calls, to `upsert_concepts` and `upsert_content`. If one call fails, we have partially defined nodes in the database.
* It would be better to send the full node, with Content as sub-objects of the Concept, in a single upsert. `upsert_concepts` accepts this since <issue id="b66b4d29-6edc-4fbe-bbbc-4cfaab6f9834" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1822/modify-upsert-concepts-so-it-accepts-embedded-content">ENG-1822</issue>.
* Roam publish already writes in a single call. Roam sync does not.

## Solution

* Remove the calls to `upsert_content`. Unify the Content computations to create the CrossAppNode type, and send it, after conversion, in a single call.

**Open decisions**

1. Does the single call go through the upsert route (<issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">FEE-890</issue>) or straight to `upsert_concepts`? 2. <issue id="8f04a7a2-c757-47d2-b12f-c918a32b77ea" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2165/refactor-roam-sync-to-use-crossappnodes">ENG-2165</issue> (Roam sync onto the CrossApp converters) is the same work. Is it a step of this ticket, or does it replace this ticket? <issue id="b90793f4-5dc0-40fc-9942-95895531ba24" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2413/decide-how-roam-and-obsidian-move-onto-the-crossapp-types">ENG-2413</issue> decides this.
3. If we use the route, does this ticket also move Roam publish to it? Publish calls `upsert_concepts` directly today, and no ticket covers moving it.

{"id":"FEE-890","title":"Create a generic upsert route that accepts all root CrossApp types","status":"Discovery","description":"## Problem

* Roam and Obsidian write to the database directly, by calling database functions such as `upsert_concepts` and `upsert_content`.
* In July we agreed the end goal is one upsert route in Next.js. It takes CrossApp types, does the conversions, and makes a single database upsert. <issue id="f4850eed-40c8-419d-bcc6-a0515a709e79" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1909/add-no-op-nextjs-content-upsert-endpoint">ENG-1909</issue> gave the reason: plugins writing directly to Supabase makes future translation and versioning harder.
* Our first attempt, <issue id="f4850eed-40c8-419d-bcc6-a0515a709e79" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1909/add-no-op-nextjs-content-upsert-endpoint">ENG-1909</issue>, required awareness of the Content/Concept distinction, introduced StandaloneContent, and did not use the root CrossApp types. This ticket uses the root CrossApp types instead.

## Solution

* A generic upsert route that accepts all root CrossApp types and does the corresponding upsert.
* Callers go through an action-specific function, such as publish, that assembles the payload. They never call the route directly from the CrossApp contracts.

**Open decisions**

1. Is one upsert route still the goal after v0?
2. When a payload is missing a schema it depends on, does the route reject the payload or fetch the schema from the database? PR <pull-request id="aadd0359-b01d-47c7-b63d-518520d40b25" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237</pull-request> fetches. Michael asked to reject. Rejecting would also avoid the extra database calls Michael asked about on 2026-07-20.
3. What is the route called? Michael suggested `/api/internal/space/[id]/graph/upsert`.
4. When the route fails, what can a user do with the error message?
5. Does "all aspects of upserting" include embeddings? Today they have their own route, `supabase/content-embedding`.

## Done When

* We can do all aspects of upserting nodes, relations and schemas with a single call to the upsert route.

## Out of Scope

* Adding accounts (could be added later)
* Optimizations

## Notes

* PR <pull-request id="aadd0359-b01d-47c7-b63d-518520d40b25" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237</pull-request> (draft) is a first version. It conflicts with main in `crossAppConverters.ts`, and its title still says <issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">ENG-2039</issue>. * History:
  * 2026-07-07: Marc-Antoine sketched a longer-term `/api/data/[space_id]` route with POST and PATCH. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/ipk4d-qiM>)
  * 2026-07-16: Michael: "The end goal is to have a single 'upsert' (likely a nextjs route) that will take in an array of content/contepts and do a single upsert." {"id":"ENG-1794","title":"Atomic upsert of Concept and Content","status":"Backlog","description":"## Problem

We upsert Content and Concept separately; we can end up in situations where the latter upsert fails, and there is a discrepancy.

## Solution

Create a combined "upsert_resource" function, which would essentially handle a Concept and a list of Contents within the concepts. (A list because we want to handle, eg. direct and full variant separately.) This can fail atomically.

**Status (2026-10-16)**

* The database half shipped: `upsert_concepts` accepts embedded Content since <issue id="b66b4d29-6edc-4fbe-bbbc-4cfaab6f9834" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1822/modify-upsert-concepts-so-it-accepts-embedded-content">ENG-1822</issue>.
* Roam publish already uses the single call.
* Roam sync (<issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue>) and Obsidian sync (<issue id="9969e706-c4c9-4405-ad9e-70f888d270b9" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian">ENG-1823</issue>) still call `upsert_content` separately. Both wait on <issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">FEE-890</issue> to decide whether they go through the upsert route.

## Done When

* ~~We have created and tested this function.~~ Done in <issue id="b66b4d29-6edc-4fbe-bbbc-4cfaab6f9834" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1822/modify-upsert-concepts-so-it-accepts-embedded-content">ENG-1822</issue>.
* We use it in Roam and Obsidian instead of the separate functions.

(Those are probably subtasks.) They are <issue id="9969e706-c4c9-4405-ad9e-70f888d270b9" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian">ENG-1823</issue> and <issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue>.

## Out of Scope

## Notes

This is less urgent now that we have recovery functions, but I think it would avoid the issue developing again. Statistics from the previous task:

Currently, we have 23335 distinct Content and 20582 corresponding Concepts, so 2753 are missing.

(Actually 23671 Content rows, but that's because each Obsidian node gets two rows for title and content.)

{"id":"FEE-890","title":"Create a generic upsert route that accepts all root CrossApp types","status":"Discovery","description":"## Problem

* Roam and Obsidian write to the database directly, by calling database functions such as `upsert_concepts` and `upsert_content`.
* In July we agreed the end goal is one upsert route in Next.js. It takes CrossApp types, does the conversions, and makes a single database upsert. <issue id="f4850eed-40c8-419d-bcc6-a0515a709e79" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1909/add-no-op-nextjs-content-upsert-endpoint">ENG-1909</issue> gave the reason: plugins writing directly to Supabase makes future translation and versioning harder.
* Our first attempt, <issue id="f4850eed-40c8-419d-bcc6-a0515a709e79" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1909/add-no-op-nextjs-content-upsert-endpoint">ENG-1909</issue>, required awareness of the Content/Concept distinction, introduced StandaloneContent, and did not use the root CrossApp types. This ticket uses the root CrossApp types instead.

## Solution

* A generic upsert route that accepts all root CrossApp types and does the corresponding upsert.
* Callers go through an action-specific function, such as publish, that assembles the payload. They never call the route directly from the CrossApp contracts.

**Open decisions**

1. Is one upsert route still the goal after v0?
2. When a payload is missing a schema it depends on, does the route reject the payload or fetch the schema from the database? PR <pull-request id="aadd0359-b01d-47c7-b63d-518520d40b25" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237</pull-request> fetches. Michael asked to reject. Rejecting would also avoid the extra database calls Michael asked about on 2026-07-20.
3. What is the route called? Michael suggested `/api/internal/space/[id]/graph/upsert`.
4. When the route fails, what can a user do with the error message?
5. Does "all aspects of upserting" include embeddings? Today they have their own route, `supabase/content-embedding`.

## Done When

* We can do all aspects of upserting nodes, relations and schemas with a single call to the upsert route.

## Out of Scope

* Adding accounts (could be added later)
* Optimizations

## Notes

* PR <pull-request id="aadd0359-b01d-47c7-b63d-518520d40b25" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237</pull-request> (draft) is a first version. It conflicts with main in `crossAppConverters.ts`, and its title still says <issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">ENG-2039</issue>. PR <pull-request id="5ecaaac4-d1a1-4231-be4e-1ea6b7532bc9" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2040-test-the-generic-upsert-route-3c30038de631">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1238</pull-request> (<issue id="d629770f-e952-4a33-80e4-3beabcd55ea3" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-891/test-the-generic-upsert-route">FEE-891</issue>) is stacked on it.
* History:
  * 2026-07-07: Marc-Antoine sketched a longer-term `/api/data/[space_id]` route with POST and PATCH. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/ipk4d-qiM>)
  * 2026-07-16: Michael: "The end goal is to have a single 'upsert' (likely a nextjs route) that will take in an array of content/contepts and do a single upsert." [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/vPFG9AOR4>) Marc-Antoine proposed `/api/internal/upsert` and replacing every Roam upsert with it. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/h9dtqAv3_>)
  * 2026-07-17 meeting: <issue id="f4850eed-40c8-419d-bcc6-a0515a709e79" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1909/add-no-op-nextjs-content-upsert-endpoint">ENG-1909</issue> canceled. Agreed to change <issue id="9969e706-c4c9-4405-ad9e-70f888d270b9" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian">ENG-1823</issue> and <issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue> to use the route; not done yet. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/eY9Br5T7n>) Michael set the rule on action-specific functions. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/SNYOjt_6j>)
  * 2026-07-19: Michael's review of <pull-request id="aadd0359-b01d-47c7-b63d-518520d40b25" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237</pull-request> raised decisions 2 to 4: [reject](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1237#discussion_r3611525400>), [name](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1237#discussion_r3611479715>), [error](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1237#discussion_r3611455206>). No replies yet.
  * 2026-07-30: Michael moved this to the Feedback team "because the details need to be discussed when we get to this ticket."
  * 2026-10-09: Sid and Michael listed it for reconsideration after v0. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/lM1fnaeHg>)","parentId":"ENG-2412","updatedAt":"2026-10-16T11:16:42.136Z"}

* Our first attempt, <issue id="f4850eed-40c8-419d-bcc6-a0515a709e79" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1909/add-no-op-nextjs-content-upsert-endpoint">ENG-1909</issue>, required awareness of the Content/Concept distinction, introduced StandaloneContent, and did not use the root CrossApp types. This ticket uses the root CrossApp types instead.

## Solution

* A generic upsert route that accepts all root CrossApp types and does the corresponding upsert.
* Callers go through an action-specific function, such as publish, that assembles the payload. They never call the route directly from the CrossApp contracts.

**Open decisions**

1. Is one upsert route still the goal after v0?
2. When a payload is missing a schema it depends on, does the route reject the payload or fetch the schema from the database? PR <pull-request id="aadd0359-b01d-47c7-b63d-518520d40b25" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237</pull-request> fetches. Michael asked to reject. Rejecting would also avoid the extra database calls Michael asked about on 2026-07-20.
3. What is the route called? Michael suggested `/api/internal/space/[id]/graph/upsert`.
4. When the route fails, what can a user do with the error message?
5. Does "all aspects of upserting" include embeddings? Today they have their own route, `supabase/content-embedding`.

## Done When

* We can do all aspects of upserting nodes, relations and schemas with a single call to the upsert route.

## Out of Scope

* Adding accounts (could be added later)
* Optimizations

## Notes

* PR <pull-request id="aadd0359-b01d-47c7-b63d-518520d40b25" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237</pull-request> (draft) is a first version. It conflicts with main in `crossAppConverters.ts`, and its title still says <issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">ENG-2039</issue>. * History:
  * 2026-07-07: Marc-Antoine sketched a longer-term `/api/data/[space_id]` route with POST and PATCH. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/ipk4d-qiM>)
  * 2026-07-16: Michael: "The end goal is to have a single 'upsert' (likely a nextjs route) that will take in an array of content/contepts and do a single upsert." [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/vPFG9AOR4>) Marc-Antoine proposed `/api/internal/upsert` and replacing every Roam upsert with it. {"id":"ENG-1794","title":"Atomic upsert of Concept and Content","status":"Backlog","description":"## Problem

We upsert Content and Concept separately; we can end up in situations where the latter upsert fails, and there is a discrepancy.

## Solution

Create a combined "upsert_resource" function, which would essentially handle a Concept and a list of Contents within the concepts. (A list because we want to handle, eg. direct and full variant separately.) This can fail atomically.

**Status (2026-10-16)**

* The database half shipped: `upsert_concepts` accepts embedded Content since <issue id="b66b4d29-6edc-4fbe-bbbc-4cfaab6f9834" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1822/modify-upsert-concepts-so-it-accepts-embedded-content">ENG-1822</issue>.
* Roam publish already uses the single call.
* Roam sync (<issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue>) and Obsidian sync (<issue id="9969e706-c4c9-4405-ad9e-70f888d270b9" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian">ENG-1823</issue>) still call `upsert_content` separately. Both wait on <issue id="eeed8918-ccd5-4056-a629-c09660968d99" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types">FEE-890</issue> to decide whether they go through the upsert route.

## Done When

* ~~We have created and tested this function.~~ Done in <issue id="b66b4d29-6edc-4fbe-bbbc-4cfaab6f9834" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1822/modify-upsert-concepts-so-it-accepts-embedded-content">ENG-1822</issue>.
* We use it in Roam and Obsidian instead of the separate functions.

(Those are probably subtasks.) They are <issue id="9969e706-c4c9-4405-ad9e-70f888d270b9" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian">ENG-1823</issue> and <issue id="dee6db2f-6461-4f53-9c6b-8a015921099f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam">ENG-1824</issue>.

## Out of Scope

## Notes

This is less urgent now that we have recovery functions, but I think it would avoid the issue developing again. Statistics from the previous task:

Currently, we have 23335 distinct Content and 20582 corresponding Concepts, so 2753 are missing.

(Actually 23671 Content rows, but that's because each Obsidian node gets two rows for title and content.)

* These counts are from 2026-05-24 and haven't been measured again.

{"id":"ENG-2045","title":"Remove Obsidian getPublishedNodesForGroups wrapper, consume shared SharedNode directly","status":"Backlog","projectMilestone":{"id":"4bbba6d9-e697-45b4-96c7-e3e4638720a4","name":"Architecture Refactors"},"parentId":null,"description":"## Problem

Follow-up from PR <pull-request id="8994f3ac-8118-41b4-8699-20066e9f5c9f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216</pull-request> review (<issue id="728d36ca-059c-4a42-87b4-5e9aed034ebc" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2019/extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-packagesdatabase">ENG-2019</issue>, @mdroidian).

After extracting shared cross-space discovery into `@repo/database/lib/sharedNodes` (`listGroupSharedNodes` returning `SharedNode`), Obsidian's `getPublishedNodesForGroups` in `apps/obsidian/src/utils/importNodes.ts` is now a thin wrapper. Its only remaining job is remapping the shared `SharedNode` shape to the local `PublishedNode` type:

* ISO strings (`created` / `lastModified`) → epoch numbers (`createdAt` / `modifiedAt`)
* `directMetadata` (`Json`) → extracted `filePath: string | undefined`

mdroidian's note: *"getPublishedNodesForGroups is now redundant. It looks like the only thing it is doing is adding filePath, which doesn't warrant an entire wrapped function."*

## Solution

Remove the `getPublishedNodesForGroups` wrapper and the local `PublishedNode` type. Have `ImportNodesModal` (and the `ImportableNode` conversion path) consume the shared `SharedNode` directly, moving the `filePath`-from-`directMetadata` extraction to the single call site that needs it.

Relates to the open question in PR #1214/#1216 — *"Are we planning on re-using a CrossApp contract for the return type?"* — and to <issue id="f1c9f2d5-4eac-47d8-b4a5-a862196ef911" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas">ENG-1986</issue> (routing Obsidian through the cross-app converters), where this remap layer disappears entirely.

## Done When

* `getPublishedNodesForGroups` and the local `PublishedNode` type are gone.
* Obsidian's import path consumes `SharedNode` (or the agreed cross-app return type) directly.
* No behavior change to discovery/import; existing tests green.

## Out of Scope

* Any change to `listGroupSharedNodes` semantics or the shared module itself.
* The broader Obsidian cross-app converter refactor (<issue id="f1c9f2d5-4eac-47d8-b4a5-a862196ef911" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas">ENG-1986</issue>).

## Notes

* Deferred out of #1216 to keep that PR a pure extraction (reviewer preferred a ticket given PR size)."}

{"id":"ENG-2045","title":"Remove Obsidian getPublishedNodesForGroups wrapper, consume shared SharedNode directly","status":"Backlog","projectMilestone":{"id":"4bbba6d9-e697-45b4-96c7-e3e4638720a4","name":"Architecture Refactors"},"parentId":null,"description":"## Problem

Follow-up from PR <pull-request id="8994f3ac-8118-41b4-8699-20066e9f5c9f" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a">DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216</pull-request> review (<issue id="728d36ca-059c-4a42-87b4-5e9aed034ebc" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2019/extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-packagesdatabase">ENG-2019</issue>, @mdroidian).

After extracting shared cross-space discovery into `@repo/database/lib/sharedNodes` (`listGroupSharedNodes` returning `SharedNode`), Obsidian's `getPublishedNodesForGroups` in `apps/obsidian/src/utils/importNodes.ts` is now a thin wrapper. Its only remaining job is remapping the shared `SharedNode` shape to the local `PublishedNode` type:

* ISO strings (`created` / `lastModified`) → epoch numbers (`createdAt` / `modifiedAt`)
* `directMetadata` (`Json`) → extracted `filePath: string | undefined`

mdroidian's note: *"getPublishedNodesForGroups is now redundant. It looks like the only thing it is doing is adding filePath, which doesn't warrant an entire wrapped function."*

## Solution

Remove the `getPublishedNodesForGroups` wrapper and the local `PublishedNode` type. Have `ImportNodesModal` (and the `ImportableNode` conversion path) consume the shared `SharedNode` directly, moving the `filePath`-from-`directMetadata` extraction to the single call site that needs it.

Relates to the open question in PR #1214/#1216 — *"Are we planning on re-using a CrossApp contract for the return type?"* — and to <issue id="f1c9f2d5-4eac-47d8-b4a5-a862196ef911" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas">ENG-1986</issue> (routing Obsidian through the cross-app converters), where this remap layer disappears entirely.

## Done When

* `getPublishedNodesForGroups` and the local `PublishedNode` type are gone.
* Obsidian's import path consumes `SharedNode` (or the agreed cross-app return type) directly.
* No behavior change to discovery/import; existing tests green.

## Out of Scope

* Any change to `listGroupSharedNodes` semantics or the shared module itself.
* The broader Obsidian cross-app converter refactor (<issue id="f1c9f2d5-4eac-47d8-b4a5-a862196ef911" href="https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas">ENG-1986</issue>).

## Notes

* Deferred out of #1216 to keep that PR a pure extraction (reviewer preferred a ticket given PR size)."}
